title: Nonempty set of reachable configuration codes
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with a finite state set $Q$, $k$ work tapes, and a read-only input tape, and let $x$ be a finite bit string and $s$ a natural number. Consider the natural numbers less than $2^{(2(3(|Q|+1)+3k+1)+2)(s+\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+2)}$ that are reachable from the code of the initial configuration of $N$ on input $x$ by zero or more steps, where each step is a valid machine transition and both configurations lie within the work-tape window of radius $s$. This set has cardinality at least one.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with a finite state set and $k$ work tapes
